property_summary: For every queried interface id that coincides with one of the two registered ERC-165 ids (IERC165's or IAccessControl's), c.supportsInterface must report support (return true); the ||→&& mutant returns false for both registered ids, so whenever the fuzzed index selects a registered id the assertion fails.
change_summary: Change || to && so the interface is only reported when both AccessControl's own and super's checks pass.
